title: How to check stock for a returned item (Harbor Supply back office)
note: Second simulated clip, used only in the demo video to show a live upload. Synthetic Kokoro TTS voice.

steps.say: Here is how to check whether a returned item is back in stock.
Open Orders from the menu on the left.
Search for the order. This one is H S one zero four two three.
Click Check stock. If it says out of stock, do not refund yet, because the warehouse has not received the returned item.
steps.reason: the warehouse has not received the returned item

steps.say: Go back to the order list and tell the warehouse team which order is waiting.
